name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – § 15, after point g – Am 82
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: (gb) Expresses deep concern that the Commission has funded or co-funded campaigns encouraging the wearing of the veil, stating, for example, that “freedom is found in the hijab”; insists that, in the future, the Union budget should no longer fund any campaigns that directly or indirectly encourage the wearing of the veil;
